chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Rizqullah ibn al-Ala, from Sulayman ibn 'Amr al-Sarraj, from some of our companions, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The clay of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) is taken from near the grave, an area of seventy fathoms by seventy fathoms from the grave.
ai.seo_question: What are the dimensions for collecting clay from the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat* delineates the sacred precinct for collecting *turab al-Husayn*, establishing a square zone of seventy fathoms by seventy fathoms around the shrine. In Shia tradition, this specific clay is revered not merely as soil but as a blessed medium for healing and spiritual connection, with the precise boundaries ensuring the authenticity of the material used in rituals and by scholars.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥasan Al-Saffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ‘Isā, from Rizqillāh ibn ‘Alā, from Sulaymān ibn ‘Amr Al-Sarrāj, from some of our companions, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:
The clay of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) can be collected from up to (a radius of) seventy fathoms by seventy fathoms from the grave.
